label: Specification for: ISSUE_ANNOTATION_NOTEMPTY
description: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:annotationSystem is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if oa:hasTarget is bdqval:Empty; POTENTIAL_ISSUE if an annotation in the bdqval:annotationSystem exists and has an oa:hasTarget referencing the bdqffdq:SingleRecord under evaluation with matching bdqval:annotationAlertIf criteria; otherwise NOT_ISSUE. bdqval:annotationSystem default = "W3C Web Annotation" {[https://www.w3.org/annotation/]} {"oa:Annotation vocabulary" [https://www.w3.org/TR/annotation-vocab/]},bdqval:annotationAlertIf default = "oa:Annotation with oa:hasTarget having as object any dwciri:term instance that is part of the SingleRecord under Test." {[https://www.w3.org/TR/annotation-vocab/]}
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:annotationSystem is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if oa:hasTarget is bdqval:Empty; POTENTIAL_ISSUE if an annotation in the bdqval:annotationSystem exists and has an oa:hasTarget referencing the bdqffdq:SingleRecord under evaluation with matching bdqval:annotationAlertIf criteria; otherwise NOT_ISSUE.
authoritiesDefaults: bdqval:annotationSystem default = "W3C Web Annotation" {[https://www.w3.org/annotation/]} {"oa:Annotation vocabulary" [https://www.w3.org/TR/annotation-vocab/]},bdqval:annotationAlertIf default = "oa:Annotation with oa:hasTarget having as object any dwciri:term instance that is part of the SingleRecord under Test." {[https://www.w3.org/TR/annotation-vocab/]}
example1: oa:hasTarget="https://example.org/bdq/test/occurrence/1", bdqval:annotationSystem default: Response.status=EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET, Response.comment="The bdqval:annotationSystem is not available"
example2: oa:hasTarget="https://example.org/bdq/test/occurrence/1", bdqval:annotationSystem="https://bdq.tdwg.org/draft/docs/guide/implementers/annotation_test_fixture.jsonld": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=POTENTIAL_ISSUE, Response.comment="An annotation in the bdqval:annotationSystem has an oa:hasTarget referencing the record"
